_comment: Square hold-ground reform on rally. A SQUARE player infantry block (60 men, which square_files lays out at 8 files -- seven full ranks plus a centred 4-man rear rank) is staged already routing, with the enemy still a long way off. Same staging as row-major-rally-reform.json and for the same reason: a rout that happens IN contact gets pinned by enemy soldier-body pressure and ground down rather than pulling clear, so it shatters instead of rallying. Here nothing is inside the rally-contact radius, so its morale climbs back toward the rout baseline and it re-forms where it stands. It rallies at about 100 wu/s at tick 200 (60 Hz dump basis), so it first pulls up over about 75 wu with its men braking in step (the anchor stops at tick 300), and stands near y=488.5 from about tick 400. The men whose slot moves are left out of the anchor coupling until they arrive, so their walk does not drag the anchor back to meet them; with that drag it stood near y=493.5. The flee turn folds _formation_angle to PI, and the rally's reform_ranks(hold_ground = true) then arms the depth reflection. The square branch used to have nothing cancelling that reflection -- its slots come from _sim_soldier_square_slot rather than the row-major array, so neither the file-major rank reversal nor the row-major cell pairing applied -- and every man walked the block's full depth through the oncoming half. The rally now deals the square's own cells again file by file from the slots the men held (#1765): each man keeps his file and his place in its order, so the 32 men of the four full-depth files keep their slots and the 28 men of the four short files each step one pitch (9 wu) forward. Measured from tick 199 to tick 200, 28 slots move 9.0 wu each; on main e81ea9fa the cell pairing moved 4 slots 63.0 wu each, the whole depth of the block. The misslotted transient (#1766) no longer fails: on 2-tick samples from tick 200 it reads 0.2 against the 0.25 threshold (0.917 on main). A second, safe player unit well out of the rout-shock radius keeps the battle from declaring defeat while the infantry is routing. The router spawns at morale 22 rather than 5: a router now flees at its real flee pace, so the later rally the old staging gave carried the block off this camera and past the far-tier demotion range before it could re-form.

overlap.reason: After the rally at tick 200 the men of the four short files each step one pitch (9 wu) forward through the square's tight lattice, and the closest body pair is under the 2.25 wu floor on 36 of the 2-tick samples from tick 212 to tick 358 (worst 0.193 wu at tick 292). On main e81ea9fa, where four men swapped ends instead, it was under the floor on 52 samples from tick 212 to tick 318 (worst 0.152 wu at tick 264). Which pair closes up was not traced. Tracked in #1772. Measured 2026-10-11.
